Molicel P28A.src: Molicel INR-18650-P28A data sheet. DC resistance 20 mOhm at 10 A / 1 s. One revision lists 8.4 A max charge; the lower 6 A is used.

Molicel P42A.src: Molicel INR-21700-P42A data sheet. DC 16 mOhm at 10 A / 1 s; 70 g max. 4.2 A is the standard charge current; a higher max was not confirmed.

Samsung 30Q.src: Samsung SDI INR18650-30Q spec v1.0. 26 mOhm is the AC 1 kHz maximum; no DC value is given, so it is used as an assumption.
